sections.heading: Introduction
sections.intent: Say what the reader will achieve, how long it takes and what they need before starting

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Instructions
sections.intent: Numbered steps in execution order, one action per step, with the expected result after each

sections.heading: Tips and Common Mistakes
sections.intent: The three mistakes beginners make and how to avoid each, followed by two tips an expert would give

sections.heading: Tools and Materials
sections.intent: What is needed, linking to product or category pages where the site sells them

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.intent: Answer the follow-up questions a reader has after finishing the steps

spec.tone: Instructional and direct; imperative mood for steps; explain why before how; no jargon without a one-line definition
